text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, on the way home...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Lucky you! ♪ Rejoice, for I
grant you
the honor of socializing with
me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa"? Excuse you, I believe you
should be
saying "thank you for the
honor."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, as for the reason I'm here... Your
trainee is
still around, is she not?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In that case, which would you prefer?
Partner running with me or practicing
King
Commendation? I shall allow you to
choose.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's where you commend me for my
brilliant wonderfulness. You are to
continually praise me
for being such a
first-rate individual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Getting roped into something as
mindless as that
will probably deal quite
a blow to our mental
well-being...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Partner running would definitely benefit 
<chrname>, but I'm worried
she
doesn't have the stamina to run right
now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Not a bad choice at all!
choice_data_list: Then let's do a tandem run.
Then let's practice the King Call.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we end up partner running with
King
Halo.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Hehe, here we go! What's my
name?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's "King"! You're supposed to yell my
name!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey! No back talk allowed! Put your
heart into it!
